description: Use this when someone asks when a Hindu festival, vrat or observance falls, or what is coming up: "when is Diwali", "next Ekadashi", "Karwa Chauth date", "Pradosh vrat this month", "festivals in November", "when is Pongal in Chennai". Returns the dated list for a place, from a start date (today if left out), for up to 120 days. For a festival in a later year, set "from" to about a month before its usual season. Dates can differ from city to city, so send the town if known; without one the list is for New Delhi. Needs no birth details.

days.description: How many days to list, 1 to 120. Default 45.

from.description: First day of the list, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.

name.description: Optional: only days whose name contains this word, e.g. "Ekadashi", "Diwali", "Pradosh".

place.description: Town or city, with region or country if known, e.g. "Pune, India" or "Austin, Texas".

name: festival_and_vrat_dates
title: Hindu festival and vrat dates
